rules.text: HQ 35 before Season 4. Each HQ level raises the hero level cap by 5.
Squad 1 power = the five tanks' hero power + troops. Drone and research % help fights, not this number.
Exclusive Weapons and gear move Squad 1 power most. Skill medals go to squad-wide skills, for fight value.
One Exclusive Weapon to level 20 before the next. Never Tesla.
Wall of Honor shards go to the hero closest to the next 50-level milestone.
Hero-tree tank research before the Tank Mastery tree.
Queue 2 stays on the Age of Oil until the third research center opens.
Filling troop slots raises total power, not Squad 1.
Light spend: season pass first, then blueprint packs on sale.

recaps.title: 3rd Tech Center open
recaps.sources: Heroes + gear video, tiers / Exclusive Weapons / Wall of Honor video, base video, research + HQ + inventory video, site checklist and notes + power details video and Squad 1 screenshot

highlights.text: Squad 1 30.14M → 30.49M (+0.35M). Tank heroes up 311K to 21.16M; Murphy and Kimberly are both past 5.0M.
Murphy's Exclusive Weapon 12 → 15 and Marshall's 1 → 2. 101 universal shards are on hand.
Williams' data chip is at 40. All five tanks now wear Lv 40 gear.
Iron Will maxed. Murphy skill 2 30 → 33, Marshall skill 1 20 → 25.
Wall of Honor: Kimberly 31 → 45, Scarlett 87 → 111, Marshall 19 → 23. Kimberly is 5 levels from a +0.5% tank attack boost.
3rd Tech Center unlocked and Oil Output I maxed. Oil Output II is 2/10.
HQ 31 now lacks only Base Expansion. Build time with buffs is 47d 1h.
Total power 154.9M → 147.5M is all troops: unit power fell 55.6M → 46.8M. Hero power rose 975K. Squad 1 doesn't count those troops, so it kept climbing.

recaps.next: Spend the 101 universal shards on Murphy's weapon, push Kimberly's Wall of Honor to 50, and rebuild troops to win back total power.

recaps.title: Phase 1 almost done
recaps.sources: Hero + Wall of Honor + tank details video, research video, site checklist and notes + Squad 1 / Age of Oil / power details video

highlights.text: Tank heroes up 567K: Marshall +330K leads, now with an Exclusive Weapon.
Unit power jumped 39.0M → 55.6M, but Squad 1 only rose 0.58M. Troops raise total power, not Squad 1.
Marshall's Exclusive Weapon is Lv 1 with 20/20 shards. Upgrade it now.
Wall of Honor: Stetmann 0 → 15, Marshall 10 → 19, Kimberly 25 → 31.
Alliance Duel maxed. Cannon Enhancement II and Oil Output I are both in queue.
3rd Tech Center path: Oil Output I to 10, then Fast Builder V and Research Enhancement V, then the Tech Center (about 9 days).
Desert Storm Battlefield starts tonight; Winter Storm in 3 days. Marshall now carries a Season Boost.
Re-baselined: Phase 1 added 0.58M, about a third of the estimate. New milestones are 31M, 33M and 35M; 40M stays the long-term goal.
New direction: HQ 35 before Season 4. HQ 31-35 needs about 56.7M oil across HQ, Tech Center, Barracks, Tank Center, Wall, Hospital, Drill Ground and Alliance Center.
HQ 31 is locked behind Base Expansion, the last node of the Age of Oil tree. Oil Output II and III both need 10 levels first.

recaps.next: Finish Phase 1. Record the Squad 1 screen before and after Marshall's weapon upgrade to measure it.

recaps.title: Baseline and the 40M plan
recaps.sources: 4 videos + skills video + Season Boost screenshot + research video

highlights.text: Kimberly (4.94M) is the benchmark; Williams, Stetmann and Marshall trail by 1.3M to 1.6M.
Williams is the softest front-liner: 27% resistance vs 50% for Murphy.
Skill 4 is maxed on every tank; skill 1 is the best medal value.
Fastest tank boosts are in the Hero tree: Armor Hardening II is +2% tank defense in about a day.
Season 3 boost is Scarlett only. Use her for zombie and monster fights.
